seo.title: Framezoo - Fast & Smooth Video Streaming
seo.description: Framezoo is a high-speed video streaming player designed to be smooth, intuitive, and easy to use. Explore rich movie metadata, sync subtitles with video streams without limits, and load subtitles from multiple sources.

hero.title: Stream fast,
hero.description: Framezoo is a high-speed streaming player with a smooth, intuitive UI, rich movie metadata, unlimited stream subtitle sync, and multi-source subtitle support.
hero.imageAlt: Framezoo high-speed streaming player showing the discovery screen

movies.title: Popular stories for your next watch.
movies.description: Browse rich movie metadata, pick your stream, and start watching instantly with Framezoo.

features.overviewDescription: Enjoy high-speed video streaming in a smooth, easy-to-use interface with rich movie metadata, unlimited stream subtitle sync, and subtitles from multiple sources.
features.subtitleSyncDescription: Synchronize subtitles with any video stream without limits—adjust timing and align dialogue seamlessly while you watch.
features.dualSubtitlesDescription: Load subtitles automatically from multiple providers, switch sources on the fly, or display dual subtitles side by side.
features.subtitleControlsDescription: Navigate a clean, responsive interface with comprehensive metadata, ratings, cast details, and episode guides built in.
features.ecosystemTitle: High-speed streaming meets an open ecosystem.
features.ecosystemDescription: Fast stream playback, multi-source subtitles, and rich movie metadata are built right into the core. Addons let you connect even more streams, catalogs, and subtitle providers effortlessly.
features.showcaseTitle: Rich metadata before you press play.
features.showcaseDescription: Open any title to explore posters, ratings, synopses, seasons, and cast details in one clean, intuitive view.
features.showcasePrimaryAlt: Framezoo title detail screen with artwork, ratings, seasons, and rich movie metadata
features.showcaseSecondaryDescription: Browse effortlessly through a sleek interface designed to get you from discovery to high-speed playback in seconds.
features.showcaseSecondaryAlt: Framezoo player discovery screen with search, categories, and title rows

addonGuide.title: Add a source without rebuilding the player.
addonGuide.description: An addon is a small HTTP service. Provide the resources you need; Framezoo handles the rest.
addonGuide.manifestDescription: Your manifest gives the app a name, supported resources, and a home for its icon.
addonGuide.resourcesDescription: Implement only the endpoints your addon needs. Responses are JSON and can be written in any language.

resources.catalog: Rows of movies or series for discovery.
resources.meta: Movie or series metadata for a title.
resources.stream: Torrent, HLS, DASH, or direct file sources.

addonGuide.runTitle: Run it, test it, install it.
steps: Serve /manifest.json and your resource endpoints from a local or public HTTP(S) server.
Test each endpoint with curl and verify the JSON shape.
Paste the manifest URL into Framezoo > Addons.
addonGuide.advancedDescription: The Stremio Addon SDK is optional. Use it for routing and serialization helpers; the protocol does not require it.

mac.title: macOS Installation Guide
mac.subtitle: Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) & Intel Mac
mac.step1Desc: Open the downloaded .dmg file and drag the Framezoo icon into the Applications folder.
mac.step2Desc: Because Framezoo is an independent open-source player without a commercial Apple Developer certificate, macOS may show: "Framezoo is damaged and can't be opened" or "Apple cannot verify this app".
step3Steps: Open Finder and navigate to your Applications folder.
In the confirmation dialog, click "Open Anyway" or "Open".
mac.note: You only need to do this right-click step on first launch. Subsequent launches can be done normally from Launchpad or Spotlight.

win.title: Windows Installation Guide
win.subtitle: Windows 10 / 11 (x64 & ARM64)
win.step1Desc: Launch the downloaded Framezoo-Setup-x64.exe installer to begin setup.
win.step2Desc: If Windows Defender displays a blue screen stating "Windows protected your PC":
step3Steps: Click on the "More info" link below the description.
A "Run anyway" button will appear in the bottom right corner.
Click "Run anyway" to proceed with installing Framezoo.
win.note: This warning appears because the new release has not yet accumulated Microsoft EV Code Signing reputation. The binary is 100% safe.

sections.title: Nature of Neutral Media Player Software
paragraphs: Framezoo is an independent desktop media player application operating as a neutral technical tool, similar to standard video players or web browsers.

Framezoo does not provide a movie library or operate video stream sources. Framezoo servers may relay subtitles from providers and temporarily process audio clips and subtitles when you use synchronization.

sections.title: User Responsibilities & Legal Compliance
paragraphs: Users are solely responsible for configuring the application, installing third-party addons, and ensuring that any streams or media accessed comply with applicable laws.
bullets: Comply with applicable intellectual property laws, the Law on Cybersecurity, Decree 147/2024/ND-CP in Vietnam, and regulations in your local jurisdiction.
Do not use the software to access, distribute, or promote unlawful content.
Verify the trustworthiness and legality of any third-party community addon before installing its manifest URL.

sections.title: Software License & Restrictions
paragraphs: Framezoo grants you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-commercial license to install and use the official desktop builds on macOS and Windows.
You may not redistribute modified binaries containing malware, misrepresent affiliation with Framezoo, or abuse project infrastructure.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability (AS-IS)
paragraphs: The software is provided on an "AS-IS" and "AS-AVAILABLE" basis without warranties of any kind. Framezoo is not liable for the availability, accuracy, or legality of external streams or metadata provided by third-party services.

privacy.title: Privacy & Personal Data Protection Policy
privacy.summary: This policy describes data processing in the Framezoo desktop application and on official Framezoo servers.

sections.title: Data on your device and our servers
paragraphs: The application stores some settings, cache, and playback data on your device. If you create an account, the server also stores your email, nickname, profile, public key, session/device details, synchronized bookmarks, progress, watch history, settings, and addons, plus encrypted subtitle provider keys if you provide them.
bullets: Email, verification codes, and request details support registration, sign-in, and account security.
Reports, bug descriptions, and attachments reach our server when you submit the Feedback form.
The website stores your language choice in browser storage.

sections.title: Purposes and external services
paragraphs: We process data to run accounts, sync devices, provide support, protect the service, and deliver features you choose. We do not sell personal data to advertising networks.
bullets: Verification email goes to our mail provider; database backups may be stored on Supabase when backup is configured.
Some service providers or addon servers may process data outside Vietnam; server location depends on the service you choose and the operating configuration.
Google reCAPTCHA may be used during registration; subtitle text goes to Google Translate when you choose translation.

Subtitle searches and downloads, audio/subtitle synchronization, and community addons may send requests through Framezoo servers and the relevant external services. Third-party addons have their own policies.

sections.title: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Account and sync data stay while your account is active. You can delete the account in Settings; the server then removes account records, bookmarks, progress, watch history, settings, and sessions. Old database backups may retain data until rotation; the default configuration keeps 7 recent backups when backup is running.
bullets: Verification codes expire after 10 minutes; expired challenge records are removed after 7 days. Sent or failed mail records are removed after 7 days.

Feedback and attachments are kept separately for support or copyright requests until they are removed on request or by the support team. Account deletion removes the account link but does not automatically delete reports. You can request separate deletion through the Feedback form.

sections.title: Your rights and contact
paragraphs: You may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of your data, withdraw consent where processing relies on consent, and submit a complaint through the Feedback form on our website. Please provide your account email so we can verify the request.

copyright.title: Copyright, DMCA & Content Disclaimer
copyright.summary: Official content disclaimer and intellectual property notice-and-takedown procedure for Framezoo.

sections.title: Intermediary Software Safe Harbor
paragraphs: Framezoo does not operate a movie library or video stream source. The application can access sources chosen by users; our servers may relay provider subtitles and temporarily process audio and subtitles for requested synchronization.
Each copyright notice is reviewed against the content and our actual role; these terms do not create an automatic liability exemption.

sections.title: Metadata & Artwork Attribution
paragraphs: Movie and series metadata (titles, release dates, synopses, ratings, and promotional posters) displayed for informational discovery are sourced from public movie databases (such as TMDB, IMDb, and TVDB).
All trademarks, movie titles, and artwork remain the property of their respective copyright owners.

sections.title: Notice & Takedown Procedure
paragraphs: Framezoo respects intellectual property rights. If you are a copyright owner or authorized agent and believe any material on framezoo.top infringes your rights, please submit a notice via our Report / Feedback channel including:
bullets: Identification of the copyright owner or authorized representative.
Proof of ownership of the copyrighted work.
The exact URL or description of the material in question so we can review and address it within 24–72 business hours.

addon-policy.title: Addon Policy & Community Guidelines
addon-policy.summary: Safety and compliance standards for the open HTTP/JSON addon ecosystem on Framezoo.

sections.title: Independent Addon Architecture
paragraphs: Framezoo supports an open HTTP/JSON addon protocol. Independent developers can host their own manifest and resource endpoints without modifying the core player.
Community addons are operated by third parties. Framezoo also operates an integrated subtitle service on its own servers, as described in the privacy policy.

sections.title: Prohibited Conduct & Content
paragraphs: In compliance with cybersecurity and intellectual property regulations, developers and users must not use the Framezoo protocol or branding to:
bullets: Distribute unlawful content, hate speech, violence, or child exploitation material.
Spread malware, spyware, phishing links, or unauthorized data harvesting scripts.
Impersonate official Framezoo releases or deceive users with fraudulent payment schemes.

sections.title: User Safety Recommendations
paragraphs: Only install addon manifests from sources you trust. You can inspect declared addon resources and remove any installed addon at any time within the Framezoo app.
